Matching opponents Strength training and conditioning athletes should be paired or grouped such that they have similar physical characteristics. Partner exercises along with competitive races or other activities can be powerful motivators for training. However, pairing an athlete that is physically more mature with an athlete that is physically less mature can invite problems. A less mature athlete may not even be able to lift the weight needed by the partner performing a selected exercise. Be sensitive to keeping athletes of similar characteristics together so that they can easily assist each other in spotting, moving weights, racking and unracking the bar, and so forth.
